name: a6fdvd-u10-iphone-workspace-footer
goal: U10 iPhone workspace footer: a remote (paired) workspace shows one status line 'Synthetic Mac · <phone>' with one Disconnect, no 'Local project'; plus addendum: connected phone home drops the 'Signed in with Google · Sign out' line and Recent projects rows get a chevron (design record specification/designs/full-pass/README.md, section U10)

evidence: Failing behavior: on a paired (online) iPhone workspace the footer shows Local project, a Shared projects line with Disconnect, and a Computer connection line with a second Disconnect; the connected home shows Signed in with Google and no chevron on Recent projects rows. Expected per design record U10 and addendum: one status line 'Connected to Synthetic Mac · Ada iPhone' with one Disconnect, no Local project, no Signed in line on the connected home, chevrons on phone rows.

Existing ui-remote-phone e2e covers the phone connected state at 320/390 and the paired workspace only through the lost-computer test, which asserts the compact region but not the footer's Disconnect count or Local project text. Reusable change: strengthened the same spec's connected test and added one paired-workspace test in the same file (same fixture, same viewport).

Red: loop record a6fdvd-u10-iphone-workspace-footer --phase red at commit 6e456a3c04, command bunx playwright test ui-remote-phone --grep 'paired workspace|connected at' fails at 'Signed in with Google' expected 0 received 1; the paired-workspace test fails at its Connected to Synthetic Mac · Ada iPhone assertion on the same unchanged main.
